THE HISTORY OF CONCRETE

John Wilson's feature documentary continues its record-breaking run!

TAKE ME HOME

The Sundance award-winner is now playing, with filmmakers and special guests Sat, Sun & Tue.

THE INCOMER

Now playing. Q&A w/ dir. Louis Paxton & actor Grant O'Rourke Fri at 7:10!

NATIONAL THEATRE LIVE: The Misanthrope

Award-winner Sandra Oh (Killing Eve) stars in this razor-sharp reimagining of Molière’s classic comedy. playing Sat, Sep 26-Mon, Sep 28.

PRETTY IN PINK X STRAIGHT WHITE MEN CAN’T DANCE

Screening, Q&A and book signing with author Addie Tsai and star Jon Cryer, moderated by Rich Juzwiak, on Tuesday, September 29 at 6:30! Tickets on sale now!

NAZA

Opens Wed, Sep 30. Tickets on sale now.

FREE LEONARD PELTIER

“As defiant as its subject” (RogerEbert.com), the documentary opens Fri, Oct 2, with filmmaker Q&As October 2, 3 & 4!

Double Header: 2 by Bruce LaBruce

One night only! Bruce LaBruce in person with new restorations of his debut NO SKIN OF MY ASS and SUPER 8 1/2 on Sun, Oct 4 at 6:00 and 8:15!
